messages:
Nora V (AE): Hi team — Prospect SaffronPay needs a compact assurance deliverable for procurement: SOC2 cover period, ISO cert, signed pen-test attestation, a one-paragraph note on Dedicated pricing/lead time, and a short blurb about key rotation/retention. They want an answer today for legal.

Ibrahim S (Solutions): I can pull the SOC2 executive summary and the ISO cert. For key rotation we usually provide a one-paragraph 'key lifecycle' note (rotation schedule, retention, replay protection). I can draft that.

Clara Q (Security): We have a pen-test attestation template but SaffronPay asked whether we notarize the letter — we do not notarize but we provide a signed PDF and a contact for verification. Also: the pen-test attestation will avoid publishing raw vuln data; we supply high-level severity summary and confirmed remediation status. Need the recipient legal entity for the "TO:" line and a confirmation they accept our template. Once we have that, we can sign in ~48 hours.

Priyanka R (Legal): Legal will sign the attestation as "Redwood Inference, Inc. Counsel (on behalf of Security)". We don't notarize. Please capture the recipient company legal name exactly (for letterhead). We'll also need an explicit acknowledgement from SaffronPay that they accept our attestation template before signing.

Evan H (Infra): Dedicated note: baseline small reserved pool uplift $6,500/mo; one-time setup $3,200. Provisioning ETA 5-8 business days post PO depending on capacity. If they require strict key retention or an HSM-backed flow, expect +$1,000/mo and +$3k one-time for HSM integration. Also request a 3-hour external scan window; best slot Thu 10:00-13:00 UTC.

Nora V (AE): Good — can someone drop a draft bundle into the assurance dataroom and paste the link here? I want to include the HSM option in case they ask. Also include a very brief FAQ: "what we redact" and "what notarization means (we don't)."

LockerBot: Assurance dataroom created: https://dataroom.redwood/assurance/SAFFRONPAY-5860005555 (view-only). Uploaded: soc2-exec-summary.pdf, iso27001-cert.pdf, pen-test-attestation-template.docx (unsigned), key-lifecycle-note.txt, dedicated-hsm-options.txt, redaction-faq.md

Clara Q (Security): Uploaded a short redaction FAQ and a sample high-level vuln summary. When SaffronPay provides the exact recipient legal name I'll generate the signed attestation within ~48 hours and attach contact details for verification (security@redwood.com).

Priyanka R (Legal): I'll prepare the signed PDF once they confirm recipient name and send back an ACK email for template acceptance. Estimated sign time within 48 hours thereafter.

Evan H (Infra): Confirming Dedicated numbers above and HSM uplift. Scan window preference Thu 10:00-13:00 UTC.

Ibrahim S (Solutions): I'll add a one-paragraph key rotation/retention blurb and a short Dedicated ETA line to the dataroom readme; will ping when done.

Nora V (AE): Thanks — I'll message SaffronPay now: include dataroom link, note signed pen-test attestation in ~48h after they confirm recipient TO: and ACK template, mention Dedicated + HSM uplifts and ETA, and propose Thu 10:00-13:00 UTC for the external scan. Will post their reply here. :pray:
